summary: Frontend-only regression of the new dark public-site redesign + CMS editor. All requested flows pass: landing page renders full dark layout (announcement, header, hero, stats, features, how, cta, footer marquee) with no console/pageerrors, all CTA links point to correct routes, mobile menu works and hero doesn't overflow (scrollWidth==390), /auth OTP + email login lands on /dashboard in light theme, /recipe/breakfast-bagel renders readable in light theme with ingredients+macros+Back-to-plan, /subscribe shows €14.99, What's included list and enabled subscribe-submit-btn, /subscribe?cancelled=1 shows cancelled-notice, /subscribe/success activate-btn flow shows activate-message on unknown email without crashing, /admin content tab renders all fields without undefined crashes and CMS save->public re-render round trip works (kicker updated then restored), other admin tabs (Clients/Weekly menu/Meals) still render in light theme.
action_items: Update /app/memory/test_credentials.md: current active code for nut_test@example.com is 4920 (doc says 8951, which is expired). Consider a stable seeding strategy so weekly rotation doesn't invalidate documented QA credentials.
critical_code_review_comments: site_content_defaults.py ships 4 how-it-works steps but the deployed DB content has only 3 steps and the title 'Three steps. No excuses.' -- request wording says '4-step how it works grid'. Not a crash, but decide which is source of truth. Currently landing renders 3 how-step cards, matches the title.

AdminContentTab passes testId prop for the hero background image field via a wrapper component; the raw [data-testid="hero-image"] query returned 0 in my sanity scan. Recommend spreading data-testid on the actual <input> so E2E selectors are consistent with the other admin fields.
